master.title: Machine-learning-based reconstruction of transient vortex-airfoil wake interaction
master.content:
A complex transient flow generated by the interaction of a single perturbation vortex and an airfoil is reconstructed from limited pressure sensors using machine learning. With small number of sensor measurements and limited amount of training flow field data, we can accurately estimate the aerodynamic force coefficients, pressure distributions over airfoil surface, and two-dimensional vorticity field. To handle the strong nonlinearities and transient features in reconstructing the complex vortex-airfoil interaction, we utilize machine learning methods assisted with several strategies including increasing the diversity of training data and training within the transient region. Multi-layer perceptron is adopted for the estimation of aerodynamic forces and pressure over surface because it can effectively extract nonlinear relationship between the pressure sensor measurements and the output variables. The combination of multilayer perceptron with convolutional neural network is also used to capture two-dimensional flow features for the wake estimation. Further, long short-term memory algorithm embedded in training models greatly improves estimation for dynamical behaviors. The above models trained with diverse flow field data can estimate the flow field spanning over a wide parameter space from only the small amounts of training data. The present study offers insights into effective data preparation and model improvement for fluid flow reconstruction using machine learning.


Authors: Zhong Y., Fukami K., An B., Taira K..

Affiliations: Ebara Corporation, University of California, Los Angeles.

Publication: AIAA AVIATION 2022 Forum, 2022.

candidate.title: AIAA AVIATION 2022 Forum
candidate.content:
The proceedings contain 962 papers. The special focus in this conference is on AIAA AVIATION. The topics include: An Investigation of the Bell X-2 and the Factors that led to its Fatal Accident; Vertical Tail Sizing and Power Split Optimization for the PEGASUS Concept Considering Certification Requirements; conceptual Design of a Hydrogen-Propelled Aircraft with Distributed Electric Propulsion; retrofit of hydrogen-powered helicopters: a sizing approach; full-Cycle Design and Analysis of the Switchblade Reconfigurable Unmanned Aerial System; Enabling Local Aerial Mobility (LAM): Design of an Ultralight Solar Distributed-Electric-Propulsion Short-Takeoff-and-Landing (STOL) Aircraft Recumbent-Electric-Bike Hybrid; HLPW4/GMGW3: Summary of Unstructured Fixed Mesh Generation Efforts for RANS Analyses; HLPW-4/GMGW-3: Mesh Adaptation for RANS Technology Focus Group Workshop Summary; Lessons Learned by the Fixed-Grid RANS TFG for HLPW-4 / GMGW-3; Comparative Evaluation of Numerical Factors for their Effect on Prediction of Aerodynamic Forces and Moments in CFD; Range Performance Flight Test of Small UAS with Winglets; airfoil Design Framework for Optimized Boundary-Layer Integral Parameters; aerodynamics of Seven Modes of Passive Flight; experimental Investigation of Aerodynamic Interactions of a Wing with Deployed Fowler Flap under Influence of a Propeller Slipstream; CFD Investigation of High-Lift Propeller Positions for a Distributed Propulsion System; FLOWUnsteady: An Interactional Aerodynamics Solver for Multirotor Aircraft and Wind Energy; a Tabu Search Algorithm for the Optimization of the Long Term Parking of Aircraft; A Future In-time Aviation Safety Management System (IASMS) Perspective for Commercial Air Carriers; a Fuzzy-based Site Selection Framework for Emergency Landings of Commercial Aircraft; numerical Investigation of Flow Over Periodic Hill.
